name: vim
readme_excerpt: If you find a bug or want to discuss the best way to add a new feature, please open an issue. If you have a question or want to discuss the best way to do something with Vim, you can join #vim, reddit.com/r/vim, use StackExchange, or one of the Maillists. What is Vim? Vim is a greatly improved version of the good old UNIX editor Vi). Many new features have been added: multi-level undo, syntax highlighting, command line history, on-line help, spell checking, filename completion, block operations…
